records.title: EMReady2: improvement of cryo-EM and cryo-ET maps by local quality-aware deep learning with Mamba
records.reason: EMReady2 improves cryo-EM/cryo-ET map quality using Mamba for an imaging task; it is not an LLM inference method.

records.title: Learning Rate Scaling across LoRA Ranks and Transfer to Full Finetuning
records.reason: The paper studies learning-rate scaling and transfer between LoRA ranks and full fine-tuning. It reports training-time memory differences (including full fine-tuning over 2x LoRA memory), but no inference-time optimization; this is outside the project’s inference-only target.

records.title: HEALing Entropy Collapse: Enhancing Exploration in Few-Shot RLVR via Hybrid-Domain Entropy Dynamics Alignment
records.reason: HEALing Entropy Collapse modifies exploration during few-shot RLVR training; the contribution is training-time reasoning optimization, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Guardian-as-an-Advisor: Advancing Next-Generation Guardian Models for Trustworthy LLMs
records.reason: Guardian-as-an-Advisor concerns LLM safety/guardian checking and trustworthiness; no inference-efficiency method is stated.

records.title: Scalable RL-based data generation and multi-resolution architecture for code-switched speech recognition: a high-performance computing approach
records.reason: The publisher abstract identifies MARS-ASR for code-switched speech recognition and reports a multi-resolution Conformer with lower inference cost, but the Springer page offers the full PDF only via paid/institutional access. The candidate is linked, so without the primary article body the method’s connection cannot be fully screened.
